data.long_meaning: Elke is derived from the Old High German name Elchilde, meaning 'Elf or Noble Elf Maiden'. In Germanic mythology, elves were believed to be supernatural beings who lived in the woods and possessed magical abilities. The name Elke carries the meaning “Elf or Noble Elf Maiden” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elke usually hope their child will grow to embody elf or noble elf maiden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
